title: AI Agents Taking Over SaaS?
full_monologue: **AI agents will replace 90% of SaaS products.** Why? Because they automate tasks faster, cheaper, and with zero downtime. Imagine AI handling customer support, analytics, and even product development—all in real time. No more clunky interfaces or monthly subscriptions. Just seamless, intelligent solutions that learn and adapt. And the best part? They’re already here. So, what SaaS product will disappear first?
